title: timer
description: One row per account, row id "current". One field, so two devices can never leave the timer half of each.

run.description: Id of this interval. It becomes the session's row id. Null when idle.

paused_at.description: Server-time ms the pause began. Null while running.

paused_ms.description: Total of the pauses that have ended.

set_index.description: Which lap of the set of four: this lap, the lap this break follows, or, when idle, the lap that comes next.
